rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a sharp upward surge (from ~$18.56 to $18.85) with the final candle printing a large-volume spike, placing price near the top of today's range at 66.2% — momentum is upward but the move is already extended intrabar and chasing here risks buying into exhaustion. The broader tape is deeply risk-off (SPY -2.06%, VIXY +14.17%) and PINS carries fresh negative earnings news (missed both EPS and revenue), creating a hostile macro backdrop for longs; yet the stock has already absorbed a -5.87% gap and bounced off the session low, making a clean short entry equally unattractive at current levels. With no clear structural level to anchor a stop and conflicting signals between the micro momentum and macro/fundamental pressure, the risk/reward is insufficient to commit capital.
